scripts.title: Auto Everything
scripts.features:
Farming Automation (Harvest & Plant)
- Smart Auto Harvest
  - Supports both single plants (like Carrots) and multi-stage/tree plants (like Apples/Oranges).
- Auto Plant
  - Speed drastically increased! Plants up to 15 seeds per cycle.
  - Auto Plant All Seeds will dynamically cycle through your entire backpack inventory and plant them consecutively with only a `0.1s` delay.
  - Automatically refreshes inventory and skips empty seeds.

Auto Buy & Sell
- Auto Buy Seeds & Gears
  - Select multiple seeds and gears from the dropdown to automatically purchase them when you have enough coins.
- Auto Sell
  - Sell your harvested crops automatically to the merchant.

Settings & Info
- Add Webhook integration and Config system.
- Added new Info tab with quick links to buy keys and join the community.
